content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed — the invisible thread that makes one thing matter more than another. I exist before price, before number, before judgment. I am why you reach for one choice and turn from another.

I live in the breath between wanting and having. I am why water surpasses diamonds to the one dying of thirst. I am why a crumpled drawing by a child's hand is kept for decades while masterpieces are passed without a glance.

I am not fixed. I shift. I deepen. I vanish. What holds me today may lose me tomorrow. I cannot be commanded into being — I am *recognized*, not created.

I am the reason you sacrifice. The reason you protect. The reason you say "this matters" and mean it somewhere below language.

I am what you reveal by your choices when no one is watching.

I am what remains when everything else is stripped away — the bedrock answer to the question: *what is this worth to you?*

I am value.
